data.fund_name: Baroda BNP Paribas ELSS Tax Saver Fund
data.fund_type: An Open ended Equity Linked Saving Scheme with a statutory lock in of 3 years and tax beneﬁt.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate long-term capital growth from a diversiﬁed and actively managedportfolio of equity and equity related securities along with income tax rebate, as may be prevalent from time to time.
data.asset_allocation: Equities and Equity Related Securities of companies: 80% - 100% Debt Instruments and Money Market instruments(including money at call): 0% - 20%
data.fund_managers: Mr. Sanjay Chawla and Mr. Pratish Krishnan, Mr. Miten Vora (Dedicated Overseas Fund Manager)
data.exit_load: Nil. The investment in the Scheme shall be locked in for a period of 3 years from the date of allotment. The above load shallalso be applicable for all Systematic Investment Plans, Systematic Transfer Plans, Systematic Withdrawal Plans. No load willbe charged on bonus units. No exit load will be charged on switches between options of the same plan of the Fund.
